save_checkpoint: save a model checkpoint with optimizer state and config to a specified job directory
load_checkpoint: load a model checkpoint from a file with optional 2D to 3D weight inflation
load_train_checkpoint: load a training checkpoint to resume training from the last saved epoch
load_test_checkpoint: load a test checkpoint for model evaluation using config-specified checkpoint paths
inflate_weight: inflate 2D convolution weights to 3D convolution weights for video action recognition models
